chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to ʿAlī عليه السلام: O ʿAlī, when I die, then wash me with seven water-skins from the well of Ghars.

key_terms.غَرْسٍ: Ghars, the name of a specific well
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْنِي: wash me; perform the ritual washing of my body

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام to use for washing his body after death?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the instruction of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the water to be used for his washing after death. It is significant in discussions of the rulings and recommended details concerning the ghusl of the deceased.
